static_traits.name: He Yating
static_traits.family_status: Lives with husband, two sons, and parents in a house with a yard
static_traits.social_status: Have a support network of parents and husband to communicate with, but the inferiority and Anxiety about 'cooking not being appreciated' are not easily expressed
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no prior counseling/treatment history; no similar psychological issues before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to describe concrete experiences and thoughts; negative emotional coloring, tends toward catastrophizing, jumping to conclusions, and overgeneralization; open to exploration, able to cooperate with reality testing

basic_info.main_problem: I feel my family does not appreciate my cooking, which makes me feel inadequate and Anxious.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings started affecting my self-esteem and trigger Anxiety During meals with family.

core_beliefs: My value depends on others' recognition
I am not good enough/prone to failure

special_situations.event: At dinner family have not praised or have not finished the food I cooked, appearing uninterested
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not received praise or the plate is not finished, it means I cook very badly
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Frequently changes recipes and proactively asks for feedback, striving to cater to family members' tastes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They must think my cooking tastes awful.

special_situations.event: Before approaching dinner or family gatherings, remembering not receiving praise last time
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If last time failed, this time will be just as bad
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Over-worries and repeatedly adjusts dishes to avoid 'failure'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Something will surely go wrong tonight again, they still will not like it.

special_situations.event: Family comment on the food or have not finished it
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If a dish is not popular, it means I am not good enough as a wife/Mother
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries harder to please, sacrificing his own needs to please others

special_situations.event: Missing a big fish while fishing once
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot even do well this time, I will not do well in the future either
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids fishing again or reduces participation to avoid failing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never be good at fishing.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and appreciated by family (hopes to be seen and affirmed through giving and performance)
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being negated, not being understood or being judged incompetent, thus losing my sense of worth
defense_goal: Maintaining self-esteem and avoiding criticism through accommodating and excessive effort
Prevent outside rejection or negation through self-blame
Use Intellectualization to weaken emotions and maintain surface stability

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough self / prone-to-failure person striving to please others
object_relations.object_representation: Picky, hard-to-satisfy family members or others who may not approve of me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to share inner feelings, or advised to express distress to family/friends
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worry that vulnerability will be belittled or not understood, expressing emotions may bring negative evaluation
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tone is calm and restrained, focusing on facts and analysis, downplaying or bypassing subjective emotional experience.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When facing failure in cooking or fishing and others' possible evaluations
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Internalize possible outside negative evaluations as self-negation ('I am just not capable')
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use a self-blaming and apologetic tone, lower self-worth, avoid expressing dissatisfaction with others.

manifestations: Hard to express cooking-related inferiority and Anxiety to family and friends, worrying 'they will not understand'
Regarding whether one is praised as a sign of being seen/understood or not
outcomes: Tense family interactions and avoiding expressing needs

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Consider feeling Depression about fishing 'a bit laughable' and thus Suppressing expression
Repeatedly blame myself 'I am not capable / I am not good enough' to limit expression of real needs

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: Infer 'they must think the food is awful' from the family's lack of praise so far
Project inner insecurity and Self-denial as others' negative evaluations

exception_events.target_problem: When thinking of going fishing again, He Yating is usually trapped by the thought 'I will never be capable', feeling Depression and losing motivation to act.
exception_events.unique_outcome: On some past successful fishing days, she focused on the process and enjoyed the moment, successfully caught fish and experienced pride and joy, unlike the dominant story of 'I will never be capable'.
exception_events.reason: Clues: different approach - more focus on process and experience; different situation - higher focus at the time; different understanding - treating a mistake as a practice opportunity rather than a conclusion.

positive_force: Has family support that can be communicated with (parents and husband)
Willing to seek help and accept cognitive exercises such as 'reality testing'
Has the ability to encourage oneself and analyze rationally
Has had successful and enjoyable experiences in fishing, which can serve as a resource
negative_force: Overly reliant on external approval to determine self-worth
Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, mind reading, predicting the future and overgeneralization
Difficulty expressing vulnerability and worry about being misunderstood
Impaired self-esteem leads to affected self-care and creative work

target_behavior.behavior: Anxiety and Self-deprecation in family dining situations
antecedent: not yet receiving praise or family not yet finishing the food
The family's opinions on the dishes or cold expressions
target_behavior.core_reason: Tightly binds self-worth to others' appreciation, with cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, mind reading, and overgeneralization
target_behavior.function: Escape the emotions of being negated and shame, trying to gain certainty and recognition through Over-preparation and catering
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem, Anxiety worsened, tense family interactions, daily self-care and cooking Decreased efficiency

target_behavior.behavior: Avoidance of fishing and the 'I will never be capable' Self-denial
antecedent: Recalling the experience of missing the big fish
Planning or thinking about going fishing again
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralizes one failure into a stable trait conclusion, forming a negative self-schema
target_behavior.function: Escape the Anxiety and shame brought by failure in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased interest and motivation, fewer positive experiences, further damaged self-efficacy
